name: Relaxed Atomic + Ordering
description: The 'Relaxed Atomic + Ordering' model, in which relaxed behaviours are explained through transformations applied over a sequentially consistent execution. The authors claim the external DRF guarantee while still permitting thin-air values — two properties known to be incompatible in general (Batty et al., ESOP 2015) — which the survey attributes to restrictions on the supported input language (for example, the absence of general conditional statements).

catSupport.note: Allowed behaviours are those obtainable by applying a sequence of program transformations to an SC execution: a rewriting derivation, not a predicate on the candidate execution.
